findings.summary: [PSL-001] forbidden state phrase: "once the per-agent grant"
findings.detail:
The phrase "once the per-agent grant" tells the model that runtime grants are not yet available, even when the runtime delivers them. Remove this language. The runtime tool list is authoritative — describe behavior in the prompt, not state.

See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-04-30-prompt-state-leakage-lint-design.md §6 PSL-001.
